HatchPattern__RoofTilesPlain__Meta.Meta__Description: Plain roof tiles for elevations - 165 mm tiles at a 100 mm gauge, each course half a tile along from the one below.
HatchPattern__RoofTilesPlain__Meta.Meta__WhyPaperUnits: Every length here is PAPER millimetres, like the dash patterns in Na__LayoutEditor__EdgeStyles__Config__.json, so the hatch measures the same on the sheet at 1:20 and at 1:100. Pattern scale adjusts from there.
HatchPattern__RoofTilesPlain__Meta.Meta__RealSize: Drawn at 1:50: a 165 mm tile at 100 mm gauge is 3.3 x 2 mm on paper. SET PATTERN SCALE TO 50 / THE DRAWING SCALE for true courses: 0.5 at 1:100, 1 at 1:50. On an elevation a roof slope is foreshortened, so a slightly smaller scale than the true one reads better.
HatchPattern__RoofTilesPlain__Meta.Meta__WhySeams: Course lines run edge to edge, 1 mm in from the top and bottom edges; the joints of the course that wraps the seam are two halves meeting on it, square on. No line comes within 0.8 mm of a side edge.

HatchPattern__RoofTilesPlain__Identity.Identity__Description: How this pattern is named, found and grouped in the pattern lists.
HatchPattern__RoofTilesPlain__Identity.Identity__Note: Plain tiles on a roof slope or tile hanging on a wall, in ELEVATION. Widen it with Pattern scale for slates.

HatchPattern__RoofTilesPlain__Tile.Tile__Description: The repeating cell, in paper millimetres.
HatchPattern__RoofTilesPlain__Tile.Tile__Note: Two tiles wide by two courses high.

HatchPattern__RoofTilesPlain__Defaults.Defaults__Description: What the pattern draws with until a use sets its own. The stroke is 0.25 pt (0.0882 mm) at scale 1 and grows with the pattern scale; a line weight typed in the panel does not. 'inherit' takes the colour of whatever carries the hatch - a vector's edge colour - until a pattern colour is picked.

HatchPattern__RoofTilesPlain__Glyphs.Glyphs__Description: Drawn about the glyph's own origin, y pointing DOWN, in tile millimetres. Strokes only: the PDF stamps a tile as lines and never fills one.

Courses.Glyph__Note: Two course lines, then the joints; the second course straddles the seam, so each of its joints is two pieces.

HatchPattern__RoofTilesPlain__Placements.Place__Note: The whole tile is one glyph at the origin

HatchPattern__RoofTilesPlain__Bounds.Bounds__Description: Scale 1 is real size at 1:50. 0.10 is 1:500 and 10 is 1:5.
